title: Sr. Power Bi Developer
jobDescription:

Develop efficient and scalable data models within Power BI that ensure data integrity and optimal performance. Integrate various data sources (e.g., SQL Server, Excel, cloud services, etc.) with Power BI, transforming raw data into actionable insights. Write, optimize, and manage DAX queries for complex calculations and data transformations within Power BI. Work closely with business analysts, data engineers, and other developers to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Create intuitive and user-friendly visualizations that effectively communicate complex data trends and business metrics. Ensure reports and dashboards are optimized for performance, with efficient data loading and rendering. Document processes, models, and queries to ensure knowledge sharing and ease of maintenance. Provide guidance, mentorship, and training to junior Power BI developers and other team members on best practices and advanced techniques.

Advanced proficiency in DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) and Power Query. Strong experience with SQL and data integration techniques. Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and ETL processes. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into technical specifications and reports.
